summary:
Disputed by the supplier: GnuTLS accepts a critical keyUsage extension it
cannot parse (an ASN.1 NULL instead of a BIT STRING). The CVE record notes
that GnuTLS does not consider this an actionable vulnerability, because its
threat model excludes attacks that need control of material inside the trust
boundary (trusted CAs and the certificates they issue). There is no upstream
fix; Debian rates it unimportant and leaves it unfixed in every suite.
